days.title: Religious History and Ridges
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Passo della Badessa
stops.detail: Not far from the parish church, stood the women's monastery of Santa Cristina, near the long ridge between the badlands known as "Passo della Badessa".

stops.name: Pieve di Pastino
stops.detail: In the locality of Settefonti lies the Pieve di Pastino, documented as early as the 11th century; declined in the 15th century and survived only as an oratory, it was later transformed into a private home.

stops.name: San Pietro di Ozzano
stops.detail: The small fort of San Pietro di Ozzano, for example, originated from the inhabitants of Claterna who, after the destruction of the city in the 5th century, took refuge on the nearby hill.
